name: strola-health-functions
description: Firebase Cloud Functions backend for Strolla Health (admin_next, super_admin_next, strola_health_flutter). See ../../Firebase-Backend-Audit-And-Design.md for the design this implements.

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore,auth,pubsub
scripts.test:rules: JAVA_HOME=/usr/local/opt/openjdk@21/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home TS_NODE_PROJECT=tsconfig.test.json npx firebase-tools@15.25.1 emulators:exec --project strolla-health-rules-test --only firestore "mocha"
